title: speq manifest v1
description: The manifest.yaml at the root of a .speq project, parsed as Manifest in speq-cli/src/manifest/mod.rs.

project.description: Project name, reported by 'speq doctor' and used in report output.

defaultEnvironment.description: Environment file used when --env is not given, without the extension.

environmentsDir.description: Directory of environment files, relative to the project root.

suitesDir.description: Directory of test specs and init.yaml files.

reportsDir.description: Directory run reports are written to.

schemasDir.description: Directory a 'schema' assertion's ref and a fixture's schemaRef resolve against.

modulesDir.description: Directory an import's module name resolves against.

fixturesDir.description: Directory a step's bodyFromFixture.ref resolves against.

http.description: Transport policy for every outbound request: timeouts, redirects, proxy and TLS.

retry.description: Retry policy applied to every api step.

enabled.description: Retries happen only when this is true.

backoff.description: How the delay grows between attempts.

retryOn.description: What counts as retryable. With neither set, nothing is retried.

networkErrors.description: Retry when the request fails to complete at all.

statusCodes.description: Response statuses that trigger a retry, for example [429, 502, 503, 504].

coverage.description: API coverage analysis against an OpenAPI specification.

enabled.description: Also switched on by the --coverage flag.

openapi.description: Path to the OpenAPI document, relative to the project root. Overridden by --openapi. Without it, coverage is skipped with a warning.

report.description: Print the covered and uncovered endpoint lists after the run.

failBelow.description: Fail the run when coverage is below this percentage. Null means no gate.

fail_below.description: Deprecated spelling of 'failBelow', accepted by speq-cli because it is what v1.0.0 shipped. Prefer 'failBelow', which matches every other manifest key.

not.$comment: 'fail_below' is a serde alias of 'failBelow', so writing both raises a duplicate-field parse error rather than one winning.
